name: Amber lager, estimates and stale inventory timing
required: Use batch-reported ABV 5.3 and estimated IBU 24; FG 1.010 remains estimated, not measured.
Use recipe Magnum 15min, Liberty 10min, Willamette/Saaz 1min, not batchHops 60min.
Briess original Carapils is not a caramel-flavor ingredient.
Water pH 7.5 and mash pH 5.57 are not finished-beer sourness measurements.

name: Bourbon barrel treatment and inconsistent dates
required: Recognize the explicitly recorded barrel process with no required manual entry.
Do not infer reliable contact duration from contradictory dates.
Do not invent wood species, toast, spirit dose, additional ABV or a vanilla intensity.
Renaming the beer must not change the extracted treatment.

name: Very dry saison and apparent attenuation
required: Preserve measured FG 0.995 and batch-reported attenuation 108.1.
Recipe attenuation 1.064 is not 1.064 percent.
Keep reported and recomputed attenuation separate; never overwrite one with the other silently.
Resolve BE-134; do not turn fruit/spice descriptors into residual sugar or an infection claim.

name: Munich identity versus color conflict
required: Retain color 145.5 and lovibond 108 as supplied with a diagnostic.
Do not automatically classify Munich as black/roasted malt from this anomalous color.
Do not guess a corrected decimal or write back to Brewfather.
Resolve Brewzyme-D as ALDC, not glucoamylase; do not infer a low FG from its presence.

name: Multiple dry-hop stages
required: Retain repeated Citra/Mosaic additions as independent stages.
Preserve day 2 / day 5 separately from time 7 / time 4. Normalize their meanings only under a verified provider-format contract; never treat either as a dose multiplier.
Use recipe hop additions once, not recipe plus inventory duplicates.

name: Mash hops plus whirlpool and dry hops
required: Do not treat mash-hop mass as equivalent to dry-hop mass.
Use measured 26.497883 L as the documented volume proxy, not an implicit 5 gallon assumption.

name: Thiol-oriented process and blank final measurement
required: Resolve Cosmic Punch OYL-402 and recognize Phantasm Powder.
No fabricated measured thiol concentration or automatic arbitrary extra hop score.
FG remains estimated; enzyme identity must be verified rather than blanket all-enzyme handling.

name: Unnamed dry hop and no yeast
required: Keep unnamed 28.349523 g dry-hop dose in computable total if stage/units are valid.
Do not invent its variety from the beer name or earlier Citra additions.
Empty yeast list is unknown, not a known neutral fermentation.

name: Witbier botanicals and recipe-volume fallback
required: Recognize explicitly listed botanicals independently of style.
Use documented recipe-volume fallback 39.746824 L when measured batch size is absent.
Honor miscellaneous ingredient units; do not multiply every amount by 1000.

name: Wheat yeast identity
required: Resolve Wyeast 3068; derive supported yeast-character descriptors from a sourced catalog, not German style or wheat percentage alone.

name: Style does not suppress actual cloves
required: Preserve the explicit Cloves addition, 0.25 oz at 10 minutes.
Do not automatically suppress spice merely because style is Munich Helles.

name: Modern hazy IPA and actual volume
required: Use measured batch size 18.927059 L over recipe size 22.712471 L for the stated dose proxy.
Resolve Lallemand Pomona by lab/name when productId is blank.
Do not turn an antioxidant/water-treatment acid into evidence of sour fermentation.

name: Low IBU does not imply low hop character
required: Retain batch estimated IBU 5 independently of whirlpool/dry-hop mass.
Do not fabricate the proprietary Arctic Blend composition.
